# README

`ppsci/externals` contains a variety of AI4S-related ecosystem development tools. These tools either have Paddle backend built-in or are directly implemented using Paddle, including:

- [Open3D](https://github.com/PFCCLab/Open3D.git)
- [paddle_scatter](https://github.com/PFCCLab/paddle_scatter)
- [neuraloperator](https://github.com/PFCCLab/neuraloperator)
- [paddle_harmonics](https://github.com/PFCCLab/paddle_harmonics)
- [deepali](https://github.com/PFCCLab/deepali.git)
- [tensorly](https://github.com/tensorly/tensorly.git)
- [warp](https://github.com/NVIDIA/warp.git)
